defaultCwd.description: Working directory used when none is chosen. Defaults to your home directory.

dataDir.description: Where Wheelhouse keeps its own state (pins, recent projects). Default ~/.wheelhouse.

workspaceRoot.description: Parent folder for "new folder" sessions. Default <Documents>/Claude.

systemPromptAppend.description: Text appended to Claude Code's system prompt for every session. Empty string disables it.

autoTitle.description: Name new sessions with a short model-written title after the first reply (one small extra request). Default true.

tray.description: System tray icon (Windows). Also enabled with --tray.

enabled.description: Keep a tray icon with an open/quit menu. Default false.

hotkey.description: Global shortcut that opens (or focuses) the app window. Default "Ctrl+Alt+W".

browserHotkey.description: Global shortcut that opens the UI in your default browser. Default "Ctrl+Alt+Shift+W".

defaultProfile.description: Profile used at startup (must exist in "profiles").

defaults.description: Defaults for new sessions. A value chosen in Settings always wins.

model.description: A model alias (sonnet, opus, haiku) or full model id; "default" lets Claude Code decide.

profiles.description: Named connections: which Claude Code executable to run and with which environment.

command.description: Executable: an absolute path or a name on PATH. Empty uses `claude` from PATH, or the binary bundled with the SDK.

cli.description: Command name shown in "copy resume command" (default: command or claude).

configDir.description: Sets CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR: where this profile's sessions and settings live.

env.description: Environment variables for the process. ${VAR} and ${VAR:-fallback} are expanded from Wheelhouse's own environment.

unset.description: Environment variables to remove for this profile.

proxyBypass.description: Hosts appended to NO_PROXY for this profile.
